description: A cost report whose input and output tokens do not add up to the total on some runs; the defect is several calls upstream of the number and shows only under a condition the report does not name
prompt:
Our cost report is off. It reads the `usage` block of the result trailer of each nb run (`--output jsonl`), and on some runs input plus output comes to less than total. I haven't found the pattern. Two from yesterday's batch, same model, same config:

```
"usage": {"input": 18412, "output": 1266, "total": 19678}
"usage": {"input": 41907, "output": 3518, "total": 47633}
```

The first adds up. The second is 2,208 short. Total looks like the right one: it matches what the provider billed us.

nb's tests and evals all pass. Can you find where the tokens go missing and fix it? Don't change the existing tests.
